definitions.full: H6821. tsaphad צָפַד verb draw together, contract (Late Hebrew id. , trams; Arabic bind fast, shackle , compare Nö M § 46 who compare Mand סאפטים fetters ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳צ Lam 4:8 their skin contracteth, shrivelleth , upon ( עֵל ) their bones. צָפָה Ezek 32:6 see צוף
